thread:
Sam P.: heads-up — nightshift canary started for runtime 3.2 + sdk 2.9 with llama4b-q4a on eu-west. Pinlist applied at 23:00 UTC, but we saw a small mismatch in SDK feature flags.
Maya R.: what mismatch? logs?
Sam P.: deploybot reported a shim-load warning: `shim: incompatible flag 'kv_prefetch' in sdk 2.8 vs 2.9` — looks like a benign fallback but it triggered a soft-pin on a subset of hosts.
DeployBot: Canary roll started (id=cny-2026-03-21-01). 12/120 hosts healthy, 8/120 soft-pinned due to SDK flag mismatch. See /deploys/cny-2026-03-21-01
Jordan L.: are the soft-pinned hosts failing inference or just falling back to fallback-runtime? any user impact?
Ravi K.: saw increased tail latency on a small percentage of requests (~0.7% p95 -> p99 spike) that align with soft-pinned hosts — likely the shim fallback path.
Maya R.: can we validate whether the pinned hosts are only older images with sdk 2.8? `kubectl get pods -l canary=2026-03-21 -o jsonpath='{.items[*].spec.containers[*].image}'`
Lee T.: I ran that and it shows image: `redwood/runtime:3.2-sdk2.8-20260320` on 8 nodes.
Sam P.: thanks. Proposal: keep canary running but add a targeted hotfix: build runtime 3.2 + sdk 2.9 with an explicit`KV_PREFETCH=off` for compatibility, push as a canary patch to the pinned hosts only.
Jordan L.: that sounds reasonable. Rollout plan?
Sam P.: two-step:
1) push patched image to the 8 soft-pinned hosts (drain & replace) with `image: redwood/runtime:3.2-sdk2.9-compat-patch` — test warmup
2) if p99 latency returns to baseline after 15m, lift soft-pin and continue normal canary progression
Ravi K.: is the patch only about env var? any kernel-level changes? we must avoid kv-cache invalidation.
Sam P.: only env var & a tiny shim guard. No model KV invalidation expected. We'll mark the patch as non-destructive.
ReleaseCoord: tagging this as a "compat-hotfix" in the rollout. Also add a note to release notes draft: "temporary compatibility guard for sdk 2.9 during canary".
Maya R.: runbook snippet for oncall if latency doesn't improve:
```
- revert patched hosts to previous image
- disable canary and route traffic to stable runtime 3.1
- escalate to eng-runtime
```
DeployBot: Patch image pushed to registry: `gcr.io/redwood/runtime:3.2-sdk2.9-compat-patch`.
Lee T.: starting drain/replace on those 8 nodes now (pods: r-cny-host-42, r-cny-host-43 ...). ETA ~6m.
DeployBot: Pod r-cny-host-42 replaced -> ready. Pod r-cny-host-43 replaced -> ready. 4/8 replaced.
Jordan L.: monitoring p50/p95/p99 and error rate. will post numbers.
Sam P.: FYI, models running: `llama4b-q4a:v2` and `gptx-lite-q8:v1` on canary. We should be careful about long-seq workloads.
Jordan L.: after 10m: p99 on canary group back to baseline, errors steady. looks good.
Maya R.: can we unpin then or do we want one more warmup window?
Sam P.: wait one more 15m to be safe, then lift soft-pin. If stable, lift and advance canary to 30%.
Ravi K.: logging note — collect `kv-cache-hits` and `shim-fallbacks` counters for the period.
Lee T.: collecting logs, forwarding to #eng-releases-telemetry.
DeployBot: Canary progression certified to proceed after manual approval.
Sam P.: I approve. Lifting soft-pin now.
DeployBot: Soft-pin lifted on canary group. Canary advanced to 30% (id=cny-2026-03-21-01 -> stage2).
Jordan L.: everything healthy in stage2 after 8m. No regressions observed.
Maya R.: will add a line to release notes: "Canary 2026-03-21: temporary compat guard for SDK 2.9; no user-facing regressions; patch applied to 8 hosts during canary, then unpinned." 
Sam P.: thanks everyone. FYI, follow-up action: infra team to add a preflight check for SDK image labels vs runtime flags to avoid future soft-pins.
ReleaseCoord: follow-up ticket created: RINF-1247 "preflight: SDK/runtime feature flag parity check".
Sam P.: closing thread. :thumbsup:
